# Hints to read: hint-stub.jsonl

30 hints of the first repeat, to read for what the checks cannot see: a leak the check missed, a hint off its rung, a place that is not the mistake's. First every hint the leak check caught, up to 10, so that a false leak shows; then hints that passed both checks, taking each tutor, language and rung in turn and the sheets as different as they can be. The picture of a sheet is the one tutor-eval draw -png draws of its file.
